comments.author: Naoyasu
comments.body: It's called a bastard sword because it's neither a one-handed sword, nor a two-handed sword. It's what some call a "hand and a half" sword, due to the large size of it, and the fact that it was a bit unweildy with one hand, but doesn't have a handle quite long enough for two hands.

comments.author: AliBayan
comments.body:
Well, many consider it not a great job, mainly due to a high switching cost, which is fine to me (I'll mostly use it for Nanban, which pays back well), but I do understand the concern.
Also, while I prefer to procure / collect all stuff I can, many prefer to buy, which makes this job far less useful for them.
It's probably a matter of the gaming ways - we all have different ones, and we all are correct :)

For me personally though, it is a great job, and it goes together well with the Chef one.
